name: First Horizon Corporation
moat_justification: Established Southeast deposit and relationship franchise with ROTCE of 15.0-15.3% in 2025 through Q2 2026, but banking is a commodity product set: no network effects, low switching costs, a mediocre ~59-60% efficiency ratio, and through-cycle returns well below the current run-rate. roic_proxy is null for FHN in fundamentals.json (banks do not file the operating-income tag), so the return evidence is ROTCE, which does not support a 7+ moat.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 3.3%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

CASH_INCLUDES_RESTRICTED: the only cash tag filed for the latest fiscal year is the combined cash + restricted-cash total and no restricted-cash tag separates it — net debt is UNDERSTATED by the restricted amount (escrow / collateral / regulatory); check the balance sheet before trusting HIGH_NET_DEBT's absence
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 1.04 vs 3-yr median 2.14 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier C (10.4%) vs bull-case tier B (15.3%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Adequate regional bank, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15% at $22.88 (weighted IRR 12.4%, IV@15% $18.02); it clears 15% only at or below $18.02, and the bank model fit is poor so size any interest to the bear case.
moat_for: Southeast/Mid-Atlantic deposit franchise and long client relationships (roots to 1864)
Diversified fee businesses: FHN Financial fixed income, wealth/trust, mortgage warehouse lending
ROTCE 15.0-15.3% in 2025 through Q2 2026 with disciplined deposit-cost management
CET1 10.5% and consistent buybacks (share count -3.34%/yr) support per-share compounding
moat_against: Commodity lending and deposit products; priced against money-center and larger regional competitors
No network effects and low switching costs
Efficiency ratio 59.88% in Q2 2026 and worsening YoY — no cost advantage
Cyclical credit: charge-offs and provisions can erase a year of earnings power
Five-year EPS growth ~2%/yr; revenue growth lagged peers
